declined.subject: production-trace-scoring
declined.reason: The subject 'production-trace-scoring' (bundle 'llm-observability') specifies requirements for continuously judging live LLM traffic with a model judge over an unbounded, streaming trace system. Context 'civicscore-scoring' is a deterministic civic transparency feature (/metodika and Souboj head-to-head MP duel) calculating and displaying parliamentary voting contribution indices and rankings from public Czech parliament data, with no generative LLM call sites, model judges, streaming spans, or live trace evaluation pipelines.
